In this video, I share the most important Apache Spark interview questions that I personally ask candidates during data engineering interviews. You’ll learn how to answer each question correctly, what mistakes to avoid, and how Spark concepts work internally.
Mock Interview:
What you will learn:
Broadcast join: how it works, ideal size limits, memory usage & Spark internals
Shuffle hash join: when Spark uses it and why
Spark architecture explained: driver, worker, cluster manager, executors
Deployment modes: local, client, cluster
RDD vs DataFrame and distributed processing
